crs: EPSG:4326 for web processing; no independent assertion of source CRS

data_plan_views.power_kw: port_count * power_kw_per_port; total synthetic site nameplate, not grid connection capacity
data_plan_views.source_url: null for local synthetic inventory, not_applicable; source_ref identifies actual input file
data_plan_views.candidate_type: parcel is a synthetic site hypothesis; candidate_subtype retains POI grounding; no parcel boundary verified
data_plan_views.demand_observations: 37,296 synthetic station/interval rows derived from operations/requests; not observed telemetry
data_plan_views.demand_cells: 9,072 ward/profile/interval rows aggregated from 27 node time series; population_or_flow is a repeated static attribute, never sum across periods/profiles
data_plan_views.wait_quantiles: linear p50/p90 over completed sessions started in slot; null when no completed session, not zero; excludes unserved waits
data_plan_views.poi_mix: JSON object of normalized weighted context category shares; encoded as JSON in CSV; context proxy
data_plan_views.scenario_config: DATA_PLAN-facing configuration view; scenario.json keeps existing strict scenario schema
data_plan_views.scenario_id: per-profile scenario IDs link cells, observations, demand, operations and requests; scenario_config maps IDs to profiles

access_matrix: P7 full demand-node/target matrix across wards, with fast/normal/slow speed assumptions. Circuity * great-circle distance, plus fixed overhead. Geometric reachability does not prove road connectivity, connector compatibility, opening hours or available capacity.
candidate_constraints: P8 per-candidate data/scenario checks and five unverified physical gates. Unknown keeps eligibility conditional; fail excludes only the affected candidate. Individual affordability is not a portfolio budget result.
context: Source-reported population and source POI/transport; no measured charging demand or traffic volume.
demand_nodes: Synthetic point-supported clusters; population weights sum to one per ward. Not a polygon grid or access matrix.
candidate_sites: Synthetic deployment proposals anchored to collected context; all feasibility unknown. Traffic labels are scenario/proxy.
demand_intervals: Poisson synthetic request counts; energy sum of synthetic request energy; low/base/high are assumptions, not probabilities.
station_operations: Peak online occupied ports and time-weighted mean; one job per port/slot. Availability can change between slots. All served jobs finish within slot.
charging_requests: One row per generated request: completed, abandoned or pending. Abandoned/pending energy is not delivered. Assignment by ward and port weights is synthetic, not driver routing.
electricity_cost_intervals: Delivered kWh / assumed efficiency * selected source price; VND before VAT and cash payment with source VAT. Thirty-minute slots align with tariff changes.
candidate_cost_assumptions: Illustrative nominal four-port costs and sensitivity cases, not sizing, grid feasibility or market quotes. OPEX excludes electricity.
finance_period_summary: Synthetic period revenue minus electricity only, not profit; NPV/payback unavailable. No annual extrapolation.
